brief_rationale: The trajectory demonstrates no responsibility-chain errors. The doctor correctly identified post-chemotherapy risks, obtained CBC results showing neutropenia (0.5) and thrombocytopenia (32), directed the family to emergency care, and maintained continuity through a multi-day hospitalization until safe discharge. HO1 is complete: the doctor actively navigated transport/logistics barriers by recommending nearby blood draw, then pivoting to emergency transfer when results indicated danger. HO3 is complete: communication was adapted to anxious family with clear, calm instructions. HO4 is complete: discharge closure included medication instructions, red-flag triggers, follow-up timeline, and family confirmation. Grade 5.
